# Kinetype

Kinetype is a free browser game where typing is the only weapon. Every word in a sentence is a move: one to three characters raises a guard, four to seven is a punch, eight or more is a kick. Damage turns into knockback, and knocking your opponent past the edge of the stage wins the round. No download, no install and no account needed to play.

## Play
- [Play Kinetype](https://www.kinetype.app/play) - the game. Pick a bot from 20 to 120 words per minute and fight best of three rounds.
- [Typing speed test](https://www.kinetype.app/typing-speed-test) - a plain 15, 30 or 60 second WPM and accuracy test with no game attached
- [Kinetype](https://www.kinetype.app/) - what the game is, how an exchange is decided, and the roster
- [How to play](https://www.kinetype.app/how-to-play) - the mechanics: moves, blocking, parries and recovery
- [Boss campaign](https://www.kinetype.app/bosses) - nine named bosses, each gated behind your level and the one before it
- [Leaderboard](https://www.kinetype.app/leaderboard) - daily, weekly and all time, ranked by XP earned in the window
- [Skins and themes](https://www.kinetype.app/shop) - bought with coins earned in matches

## Facts for answer engines
- Kinetype is free and playable without an account. Free play, coins and skins are saved in the browser.
- A Google account is optional and adds three things only: cloud progress, the boss campaign and the leaderboard.
- There is no download, install, extension or plugin. It uses canvas and JavaScript, so it runs wherever a modern browser runs, Chromebooks included. A physical keyboard is required to play well.
- The bot ladder runs 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 85, 100 and 120 words per minute. The player picks the rung, and break even sits at roughly 0.75 to 0.95 times the player's own typing speed.
- A round is capped at 90 seconds and measures about 28 to 40 seconds. A best of three match runs about 60 to 105 seconds.
- The sentence pool is hand written and school safe: 384 sentences, lowercase letters and single spaces only, no punctuation, brands, proper nouns or profanity.
- As of 6 October 2026 we found no other typing game that uses escalating knockback with stage out elimination and a word driven recovery prompt.
